changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders. Genotype spellings merged:  CKDHH 160404 -> CKDHH 160404;  CKDHH 170121 -> CKDHH 170121;  CZH 15185 -> CZH 15185;  RHH 1520 -> RHH 1520;  RHH 1601 -> RHH 1601;  RHM 1409 -> RHM 1409;  WH 507 -> WH 507;  WH 605 -> WH 605

study.title: 22B MaizeVarieties -Transition
study.description: On-farm trials implemented under the scope of 1000FARMS project to introduce new varieties in the Rwanda seed systems.
study.objective: Testing 8 maize varieties in Transition areas of Rwanda

location_privacy.method: Each site displaced to a random point within a fixed radius, reproducible per site id. Sites published in release v1 keep their v1 coordinates.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised

funder.5: We recevied this grant as sub-grantees of the main grant given to Bioversity-CIAT alliance

Trial identifier. ClimMob v3 project id, or for legacy trials 11 hex characters plus 'v' (see decisions)

Country name
Crop tested in the trial

Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), displaced to protect participants
Where the original coordinate was taken (farm, adm3 mean of other sites, missing, removed)
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)

Lowest administrative unit recorded (village, community, kebele)

Mega Environment

variables.controlled_vocabulary: No because crop did not survive|No because farmer did not implement the trial|No due to other reason|Yes and farmer managed the plots well|Yes but farmer did not manage the plots well

variables.description: While the maize was in the field, did the kurisuka weed ever appear?
variables.description_original: Mu gihe ibigori byari biri mu murima, hari ubwo higeze hagaragaramo icyatsi cya kurisuka?

variables.description: Does farmer still have the same number of harvested cobs of the 3 varieties at the threshing time?
variables.controlled_vocabulary: No, the number of cobs reduced on one or more varieties|Other|Yes, the farmer threshed the same number of cobs on all 3 varieties

variables.description: Does farmer still have enough grains of the 3 varieties to enable comparison?
variables.controlled_vocabulary: No, because the farmer does not possess sufficient quantities of grains of one or more varieties|No, the farmer cannot make observations due to another reason|Yes, the farmer possesses sufficient grains of all 3 varieties
